purpose: Federated read-only learning sources for the 100-Day Data Analyst Business Trainer. External repositories remain authoritative in their own GitHub repositories; this repository stores discovery metadata and integration rules.

runtime_rules.content_policy: Do not copy external repository content into published curriculum unless explicitly licensed and attribution requirements are satisfied.
runtime_rules.discovery: Use the repository metadata and GitHub tree/content endpoints to discover current resources at runtime.
runtime_rules.freshness: External resources may change independently; the consuming application should tolerate missing or renamed paths.
runtime_rules.attribution: Display source repository name and link whenever external content is surfaced.
runtime_rules.local_authority: 100day-of-learning-DA remains authoritative for its own curriculum, datasets, validation rules, and learner progression.
runtime_rules.fallback: If an external repository is unavailable, the core 100-day learning path must continue to function using local resources.
runtime_rules.security: Treat external JSON, Markdown, CSV, and code as untrusted content. Do not execute fetched JavaScript or shell commands.
